parameterBinding.bindingRule: Bind placeholders only via prepared parameters or driver-native named binding — never concatenate untrusted strings into SQL.

recommendedSequence: 1. Record Phase A baseline (identities, ownership, pgcrypto, migration state).
2. Provision MIGRATION_OWNER (may be NOLOGIN) and run Prisma migrations as that owner.
3. CREATE EXTENSION pgcrypto if absent (requires migration-owner privilege).
4. Create GENERAL_APP_RUNTIME and TRUSTED_ATTESTATION_ISSUER roles + grants (no PUBLIC bypass).
5. Execute Phase B certification against effective privileges (has_* / pg_has_role).
6. Only then consider issuer process credential injection (separate env).
notes: R1 migration issues CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pgcrypto — extension owner and migration-owner capability remain production-unverified until Phase A/B executed.
Do not treat missing future issuer roles as success in Phase A — record NOT_PROVISIONED.

phaseA.description: Discover existing production facts before role provisioning. Missing future roles are NOT_PROVISIONED, not failures.

checks.sql: SELECT session_user::text AS session_user, current_user::text AS current_user;
SELECT extname::text AS extname, extversion::text AS extversion, pg_get_userbyid(e.extowner)::text AS extension_owner FROM pg_extension e WHERE extname = 'pgcrypto';

SELECT expected.rolname, r.rolcanlogin, r.rolsuper, r.rolcreaterole, (r.oid IS NOT NULL) AS role_exists FROM (VALUES (:migration_owner::text), (:general_app_runtime::text), (:trusted_attestation_issuer::text)) AS expected(rolname) LEFT JOIN pg_roles r ON r.rolname = expected.rolname ORDER BY expected.rolname;
SELECT migration_name, finished_at IS NOT NULL AS applied FROM _prisma_migrations WHERE migration_name LIKE '%battery_hv_h4_a3_integrity_attestation%' ORDER BY migration_name;

SELECT c.relname::text AS table_name, pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner)::text AS owner FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'public' AND c.relname IN ('battery_hv_charge_session_evidence_integrity_attestations', 'battery_hv_charge_session_evidence_revisions', 'battery_hv_charge_session_evidence_acks') AND c.relkind = 'r' ORDER BY 1;

SELECT p.proname::text AS function_name, pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner)::text AS owner FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'public' AND p.proname IN ('m3_3_hv_h4_a3_lock_revision_and_ack_for_issuance_v1', 'm3_3_hv_h4_a3_invalidate_attestations_for_revision_v1', 'm3_3_hv_h4_a3_invalidate_attestations_for_ack_v1') ORDER BY 1;

SELECT :general_app_runtime::text AS role_name, has_table_privilege(:general_app_runtime, :attestation_table, 'INSERT') AS app_insert_attestation, has_table_privilege(:general_app_runtime, :attestation_table, 'UPDATE') AS app_update_attestation, has_table_privilege(:general_app_runtime, :attestation_table, 'DELETE') AS app_delete_attestation, has_function_privilege(:general_app_runtime, :lock_function, 'EXECUTE') AS app_execute_lock WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = :general_app_runtime);

phaseB.description: Certify provisioned roles, effective privileges, ownership, and migration state. Fails when required roles missing.

checks.sql: SELECT expected.rolname, r.rolcanlogin, r.rolsuper, (r.oid IS NOT NULL) AS role_exists FROM (VALUES (:general_app_runtime::text), (:trusted_attestation_issuer::text)) AS expected(rolname) LEFT JOIN pg_roles r ON r.rolname = expected.rolname ORDER BY expected.rolname;
SELECT rolname, rolcanlogin, rolsuper FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = :migration_owner;

SELECT has_table_privilege(:general_app_runtime, :attestation_table, 'INSERT') AS app_insert, has_table_privilege(:general_app_runtime, :attestation_table, 'UPDATE') AS app_update, has_table_privilege(:general_app_runtime, :attestation_table, 'DELETE') AS app_delete;

SELECT has_table_privilege(:general_app_runtime, :revision_table, 'UPDATE') AS app_update_revision, has_table_privilege(:trusted_attestation_issuer, :revision_table, 'UPDATE') AS issuer_update_revision, has_table_privilege(:trusted_attestation_issuer, :revision_table, 'SELECT') AS issuer_select_revision, has_table_privilege(:general_app_runtime, :ack_table, 'UPDATE') AS app_update_ack, has_table_privilege(:trusted_attestation_issuer, :ack_table, 'UPDATE') AS issuer_update_ack;

SELECT pg_has_role(:general_app_runtime, :trusted_attestation_issuer, 'member') AS app_member_of_issuer, pg_has_role(:trusted_attestation_issuer, :general_app_runtime, 'member') AS issuer_member_of_app;

SELECT 'table' AS kind, c.relname::text AS name, pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner)::text AS owner FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'public' AND c.relname IN ('battery_hv_charge_session_evidence_integrity_attestations', 'battery_hv_charge_session_evidence_revisions', 'battery_hv_charge_session_evidence_acks') UNION ALL SELECT 'function', p.proname::text, pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner)::text FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'public' AND p.proname IN ('m3_3_hv_h4_a3_lock_revision_and_ack_for_issuance_v1', 'm3_3_hv_h4_a3_invalidate_attestations_for_revision_v1', 'm3_3_hv_h4_a3_invalidate_attestations_for_ack_v1') ORDER BY kind, name;
SELECT migration_name FROM _prisma_migrations WHERE finished_at IS NOT NULL AND migration_name LIKE '%battery_hv_h4_a3_integrity_attestation%' ORDER BY migration_name;
SELECT extname::text FROM pg_extension WHERE extname = 'pgcrypto';
